CSS.HC.Indoor_Day_0: I woke up early today and brewed us some coffee – here’s a cup, honey.[395]$1#$b#Coffee was a lifesaver for me during med school and it still is during stressful shifts.#$e#Don’t drop the mug, dear. You’ll hurt yourself.$1
CSS.HC.Indoor_Day_0_GN: I woke up early today and brewed us some coffee – here’s a cup, {{TermofEndearment}}.[395]$1#$b#Coffee was a lifesaver for me during med school and it still is during stressful shifts.#$e#Don’t drop the mug, {{TermofEndearment}}. You’ll hurt yourself.$1
CSS.HC.Indoor_Day_1: Good morning, dear. I made you a hearty breakfast today. [195 199 200 201 235 236]#$b#You work so hard for our family to not fuel yourself with a meal before you go.$1#$e#You know, it’s my job to take care of you, too, not just my patients.
CSS.HC.Indoor_Day_1_GN: Good morning, {{TermOfEndearment}}. I made you a hearty breakfast today. [195 199 200 201 235 236]#$b#You work so hard for our family to not fuel yourself with a meal before you go.$1#$e#You know, it’s my job to take care of you, too, not just my patients.
CSS.HC.Indoor_Day_2: When I'm not reviewing my patients' charts, I like to finish up chores around the house during my days off.#$b#It feels oddly relaxing but satisfying to keep our home well-maintained.
CSS.HC.Indoor_Night_0: Between exams and clinical rotations, I used to rely on survival meals to get by in med school. It still feels surreal that I can now enjoy my rest days and cook a real meal for me and for someone I love.#$b#I spent the evening cooking us dinner, dear. Enjoy!$h[199 207 212 606]
CSS.HC.Indoor_Night_1: Did everything go smoothly on the farm today, @?#$b#Ah, really? That's good to know.$h#$b#Me? I sorted some paperwork and went through the Clinic's supply log. Been meaning to do that for days.$h#$e#Ah, everything looks in order now.$h
CSS.HC.Indoor_Night_2: I get a lot of satisfaction working at the Clinic but I didn’t realize how much I needed a slow day until I had one.#$b#Just me, our farmhouse, and the thought of my favorite person coming home to me.
CSS.HC.Outdoor_0: You've turned this plot of land into a haven of life, @. I can't help but be amazed everyday knowing that my spouse built all of this with their own two hands.$h#$b#I'm sure your Grandfather would be so proud of you.
CSS.HC.Outdoor_1: It is a privilege to watch the golden glow of sunlight over our beautiful farm every morning. I praise Yoba that I get to come home to the person who made it all possible.#$b#You are a pillar of this town, hon. I've never been more honored that you chose me to be your husband.
CSS.HC.Outdoor_1_GN: It is a privilege to watch the golden glow of sunlight over our beautiful farm every morning. I praise Yoba that I get to come home to the person who made it all possible.#$b#You are a pillar of this town, {{TermOfEndearment}}. I've never been more honored that you chose me to be your husband.
CSS.HC.Outdoor_2: Ah, I’ll never get tired of waking up to this breathtaking view, @. $h#$b#Maybe I could take a few days off and act as your farming assistant?$h#$e#Hey! That was one time!$h#$b#%Harvey chuckles to himself, recalling how his first time 'helping' on the farm landed him in the Clinic with a sprained ankle.
CSS.HC.funReturn_Harvey: Hey, hon. I'm back. Feels good to be home. How was your day?#$b#Today was nothing fancy. I let my thoughts drift for a bit while I was outside.#$b#Sometimes, it's enough to shake all of tension out of my body.#$e#%You can barely finish a response before he wraps you in his arms and presses a lingering kiss on your forehead.#$b#I'm finally home, @.$h
CSS.HC.funReturn_Harvey_GN: Hey, {{TermofEndearment}}. I'm back. Feels good to be home. How was your day?#$b#Today was nothing fancy. I let my thoughts drift for a bit while I was outside.#$b#Sometimes, it's enough to shake all of tension out of my body.#$e#%You can barely finish a response before he wraps you in his arms and presses a lingering kiss on your forehead.#$b#I'm finally home, @.$h
CSS.HC.Hospital_Tue_0: Just got through half the paperwork for this season's reports. Thankfully, we're still within budget, so that's a relief.$h
CSS.HC.Hospital_Tue_1: I've been sorting through vaccine schedules on one end and figuring out where the missing antiseptics are on the other.$2#$b#Sigh, I think I need another cup of coffee to get through work today, @.$2
CSS.HC.Hospital_Tue_2: Is something the matter, @? Are you alright?$8#$b#Visting you favorite doctor?$8#$b#Ah, I see... You had me worried for a second!$h#$b#Can’t say I mind the unscheduled visit. Especially when it’s you.$h
CSS.HC.Hospital_Thu_0: Ah, I'm halfway finished from going over my patients' notes. It's a little tedious but I take pride in being meticulous over my work.#$b#Thanks for coming by..$h
CSS.HC.Hospital_Thu_1: I've been sorting out the villagers' allergy logs. The town may be small, but every one of my patients matter.#$b#You walking in here might just be the highlight of my shift, though.$h
CSS.HC.Hospital_Thu_2: Sigh, I've got a migraine just from comparing these price quotes from different medical suppliers.#$b#It’s...trickier than I’d like to admit.$2
CSS.HC.jobReturn_Harvey: I hope you didn’t wait up too long for me, @. I reviewed some of my patients charts before I left.#$b#You must be tired, too. Come, let's lie down.#$e#Doctor's orders.$h
CSS.HC.Harvey_AfterWedding: Everything still feels surreal, @. I still can't believe we're married.$4#$b#@, I meant every word in my vows. I will continue to cherish you, love you, care for you, and stand by your side for better or for worse.#$e#I love you, @.
CSS.HC.spouseRoom_Harvey_0: Oh hi, @. I didn't see you there.#$b#You know, I used to mentally beat myself up for not fitting the standards of becoming a pilot. Now though, I think I just rerouted to a bigger purpose.$h
CSS.HC.spouseRoom_Harvey_1: I really like this room we built on the house for my hobbies. It's so much more relaxing here than in my old apartment.$h#$e#Thank you for making room for that part of me, too.$4
CSS.HC.spouseRoom_Harvey_2: I'm working on a new replica of a plane model I saw in a book as a kid.#$b#You know, I had to unlearn the idea that all of this is childish. Then again, there’s nothing wrong with holding on to something that made you dream.$h
CSS.HC.spouseRoom_Harvey_3: It's amazing to think that if things were a little bit different, I would be flying over the blue skies of Pelican Town by now.$h#$b#Still, I wouldn't trade a life of soaring the skies if I don't have you in it.
CSS.HC.NoBed_0: I haven't slept this uncomfortably since med school...$2#$b#Eurgh, my back hurts.#$b#
CSS.HC.NoBed_1: Eurgh, I didn't get any sleep last night..$2#$e#I don’t want to assume that you’re mad at me, but the lack of bed space last night felt a bit...personal.$
CSS.HC.Rainy_Day_0: It's a myth that rain gives you the flu but I'd rather not take my chances to see you get sick or injured, seeing how muddy it is outside.#$b#Please take care out there, @. I often worry about you.$2
CSS.HC.Rainy_Day_1: Hmm, we should patch that leaky roof soon...#$b#Prolonged dampness can lead to the growth of mold and that’s the last thing we want in the house.$2
CSS.HC.Rainy_Day_2: It was so incredibly lonely living above the Clinic by myself... I'm much happier now having you beside me.$h
CSS.HC.Rainy_Night_0: The distinct smell of the earth when it rains actually comes from the chemical compounds of tiny microorganisms.#$b#It's fascinating how even the tiniest of organisms have such an impact on how we perceive nature.$h
CSS.HC.Rainy_Night_1: You've had a long day, haven't you? How about I make you something warm to drink, give you a massage, and call it a night?#$e#Sounds like a plan, @.$h
CSS.HC.Rainy_Night_2: I used to grumble about how the rain would stop me from watching the planes go by. But now, I'm starting to like it.#$b#Knowing I get to curl up next to you and feel your warmth as we drift off to sleep? It's the best.$4#$e#This life with you, I wouldn't trade that for anything.$h
CSS.HC.Rainy_Night_3: Back in med school, rainy nights like this helped me stay sane during all-nighters. In a way, it was therapeutic.#$b#But this… this is the first time I’ve had space to actually enjoy it and breathe easier.
CSS.HC.Good_0: I had some extra time today and figured I could cook something for you. You can pack it for tomorrow’s lunch if you like, dear.$h[231 236 230 234 342 196 606 240 606]
CSS.HC.Good_0_GN: I had some extra time today and figured I could cook something for you. You can pack it for tomorrow’s lunch if you like, {{TermofEndearment}} $h.[231 236 230 234 342 196 606 240 606]
CSS.HC.Good_1: Contrary to popular belief, breakfast isn’t factually the most important meal of the day. All of your meals are nutritionally as important.#$b#Still, it wouldn’t hurt if I cooked you breakfast. I hope you enjoy this, dear.$1 [195 199 200 201 235 236]
CSS.HC.Good_1_GN: Contrary to popular belief, breakfast isn’t factually the most important meal of the day. All of your meals are nutritionally as important.#$b#Still, it wouldn’t hurt if I cooked you breakfast. I hope you enjoy this, {{TermofEndearment}}.$1[195 199 200 201 235 236]
CSS.HC.Good_2: Taking care of your mental well-being is just as vital as taking care of your physical health.#$b#If there's anything bearing on your mind, I'm always here to listen.
CSS.HC.Good_3: Sigh, I know some of the villagers are a little bit… hesitant to visit me during their annual routine check-up but it’s better to detect any underlying illnesses early on.$2#$b#Ah! That reminds me. Maybe I should schedule you for an annual check-up too.#$b#We can’t have you skipping out on your health, can we?$h#$e#Why are you giving me that look? I’m just teasing.$h
CSS.HC.Good_4: Please promise me that you’ll take a moment to rest from time to time. You work so hard for us every day and I can’t help but worry if you’re doing alright.
CSS.HC.Good_5: Even before we were married, your name would come up in passing from my patients. The townsfolk admire how you treat others, you know?#$b#I can’t take any credit for how well-liked you are, but I can't help but be so proud of you.$h#$e#It still catches me off guard sometimes remembering that you’re mine, @.$4
CSS.HC.spring_Tue: I'll be at work today, @. Don't forget to take care of yourself while you're tending to our farm, alright?#$b#I made something for you to eat, just in case. [231 236 230 234 342]#$e#In case you need me for anything, come visit me.#$b#I love you.$h
CSS.HC.spring_Thu: I'll be at work today, @. Don't forget to take care of yourself while you're tending to our farm, alright?#$b#I made something for you to eat, just in case. [231 236 230 234 342]#$e#In case you need me for anything, come visit me.#$b#I love you.$h
CSS.HC.spring_1: Here's to another year with you, honey! I want you to know that you mean the world to me.$4#$b#Oh! By the way, I put some of my paycheck to buy you some farming essentials for %farm Farm. Your crops deserve only the best care, just like you, @.$h#$action AddMoney 10000 #$action AddItem (O)369 15
CSS.HC.spring_1_GN: Here's to another year with you, {{TermOfEndearment}}! I want you to know that you mean the world to me.$4#$b#Oh! By the way, I put some of my paycheck to buy you some farming essentials for %farm Farm. Your crops deserve only the best care, just like you, @.$h#$action AddMoney 10000 #$action AddItem (O)369 15
CSS.HC.spring_2: Annual check-ups are such a great opportunity to reconnect with the people in the valley.#$b#I get to really see how my patients are doing, both emotionally and physically.  Personally, it's made my work feel so much more meaningful.
CSS.HC.spring_3: Evelyn came by the Clinic for their check-up with me yesterday. It's always such a joy to see her in good spirits.#$b#Oh, by the way, she insisted on bringing us some cookies before she left.[223]$h#$e#They're shaped like little flowers, too! What a thoughtful gesture..$h
CSS.HC.spring_10: Everything feels so vibrant with all of the flowers and trees blooming around the valley.#$b#I do feel bad that one of our villagers need to take a constant trip to the Clinic for their pollen allergies, though.$2
CSS.HC.spring_11: I have an appointment with Vincent today. I remember when Jodi brought him in as a toddler.$h#$b#He's still a little apprehensive about visiting the doctor's office, but watching him grow over the years has been nothing but heartwarming.$h
CSS.HC.spring_26: I had a follow-up check-up today with George and it’s such a relief to see his health be in good shape.#$b#You know, patients need their doctor to listen to them and I’m honored he’s softened up and actually heed my advice.
CSS.HC.spring_27: Summer is just around the corner, hun. Remember to stay hydrated while you're out in the fields, alright?#$b#The last thing I want is for you to get dehydrated or suffer from heat stroke$2#$b#Keep this with you, alright? #$action AddItem (O)403 15
CSS.HC.spring_27_GN: Summer is just around the corner, {{TermOfEndearment}}. Remember to stay hydrated while you're out in the fields, alright?#$b#The last thing I want is for you to get dehydrated or suffer from heat stroke$2#$b#Keep this with you, alright? #$action AddItem (O)403 15
CSS.HC.summer_1: Ah, the heat snuck in so early today. It's radiating with so much warmth in the house.#$b#Take this before you work, @. Prolonged exposure to the sun can deplete the body of water and essential nutrients, you know?[349][349][(H)4]
CSS.HC.summer_2: Annual check-ups are such a great opportunity to reconnect with the people in the Valley.#$b#I get to really see how my patients are doing, both emotionally and physically. Personally, it's made my work feel so much more meaningful.$h
CSS.HC.summer_3: Evelyn came by the Clinic for their check-up with me yesterday. It's always such a joy to see her in good spirits.#$b#Oh, by the way, she insisted on bringing us some cookies before she left.[223]$h#$e#They're shaped like little palm trees, too! What a thoughtful gesture..$h
CSS.HC.summer_9: If I ever got to specialize, pediatrics or geriatrics would be my pick.#$b#But honestly, I'm just happy that I get to help everyone in need.$h
CSS.HC.summer_10: Have you thought about what to bring to the luau soup this year? I love seeing the community come together like this for a hearty meal.$h#$b#Let's make sure we bring some high-quality healthy produce to share with everyone, @.
CSS.HC.summer_10_GN: Have you thought about what to bring to the luau soup this year? I love seeing the community come together like this for a hearty meal.$h#$b#Let's make sure we bring some high-quality healthy produce to share with everyone, {{TermofEndearment}}.
CSS.HC.summer_23: George's seasonal check up is today. Mr. Mulner isn't exactly too thrilled to visit me at the Clinic, but it does help that Evelyn is there to calm him down.#$b#I can only hope we get to to grow old and continue supporting each other in the same way.$4#$e#Minus the grumpy part, of course.$h
CSS.HC.summer_Wed: I’m trying to keeping an eye out for any signs of heat-related illnesses in the community.#$b#The combination of heat and humidity can do a number on people, you know?$2
CSS.HC.summer_25: It's nothing major, but I received my mid-year incentive for my work at the Clinic and wanted to share a portion of my pay with you.$h #$action AddMoney 10000#$b#It's not a lot but I thought we could use it to fund the next season's crops.#$e#No better investment than in what we build together after all.$h
CSS.HC.summer_28: Did you know that approximately 50% of jellyfish are bioluminescent? Their glowing hues actually act as a defense against predators and to attract prey.#$b#Still, it's quite breathtaking to witness every year.$h#$e#Ah, I feel quite lucky to be given a chance to witness their long journey.
CSS.HC.summer_Tue: Ah, it's so humid today...$2#$b#As always, I'll be at work today, @. Don't forget to take care of yourself while you're tending to our farm, alright?#$b#I made something for you to eat, just in case. [200 218 240 609 610 618]#$e#Don't forget to hydrate. I love you.$h
CSS.HC.summer_Thu: Ah, it's so humid today...$2#$b#As always, I'll be at work today, @. Don't forget to take care of yourself while you're tending to our farm, alright?#$b#I made something for you to eat, just in case. [200 218 240 609 610 618]#$e#Don't forget to hydrate. I love you.$h
CSS.HC.fall_1: Ah, it’s starting to get a bit chilly in the morning. It’s so easy to catch a cold or a seasonal flu this time of year.#$b#I know it's gonna be a busy day ahead for you though so I packed you lunch early this morning.$h [230 235 236 237]
CSS.HC.fall_2: Annual check-ups are such a great opportunity to reconnect with the people in the Valley.#$b#I get to really see how my patients are doing, both emotionally and physically. Personally, it's made my work feel so much more meaningful.$h
CSS.HC.fall_3: Evelyn came by the Clinic for their check-up with me yesterday. It's always such a joy to see her in good spirits.#$b#Oh, by the way, she insisted on bringing us some cookies before she left.[223]$h#$e#They're shaped like little pumpkins, too! What a thoughtful gesture..$h
CSS.HC.fall_4: Oh, the crops in season would be perfect for a hearty Super Meal. Why not plant some bokchoy and cranberries on our farm?
CSS.HC.fall_12: I feel like I've come to that age where I just can't follow modern vernacular anymore.$2#$b#The other day, Sam told me he's taking the 'W' after his checkup.#$e#I do suppose he meant water. Hydrating is good. Good for him.$h
CSS.HC.fall_16: Are you joining the Stardew Valley Fair, hon? I have the highest faith in you.$h#$b#Our high-quality produce is the product of your love and care for the farm. I'll be rooting for you on the side.$h
CSS.HC.fall_16_GN: Are you joining the Stardew Valley Fair, {{TermOfEndearment}}? I have the highest faith in you.$h#$b#Our high-quality produce is the product of your love and care for the farm. I'll be rooting for you on the side.$h
CSS.HC.fall_23: Mr. Mulner gets a tad grouchier when it starts getting chilly, but I think it’s just his way of coping.#$b#Hmm, I think I'll review his charts again this evening.
CSS.HC.fall_27: I don't normally endorse consuming sugary treats, but I guess there's no harm in having a treat now and then. [222 234 238 608 612]#$e#I hope you enjoy them, hon.$h
CSS.HC.fall_27_GN: I don't normally endorse consuming sugary treats, but I guess there's no harm in having a treat now and then. [222 234 238 608 612]#$e#I hope you enjoy them, {{TermOfEndearment}}.$h
CSS.HC.fall_Tue: @, I'll be at work today. It's starting to get chilly so don't forget to bundle up and take care of yourself while you're tending to our farm, alright?#$b#I made something for you to eat, just in case.[230 231 342 234 236]#$e#In case you need me for anything, come visit me.#$b#I love you.$h
CSS.HC.fall_Thu: I'll be at work today, as always. It's starting to get chilly already so don't forget to take care of yourself while you're tending to our farm, alright?#$b#I made something for you to eat, just in case. [230 231 342 234 236]#$e#In case you need me for anything, come visit me.#$b#I love you.$h
CSS.HC.winter_Sun: With the drop in temperature, winter can bring a lot of health risks. I’ve be making sure to remind the townsfolk to stay hydrated and drink their vitamins for extra precaution.#$e#Hmm, do you think Mayor Lewis would mind if I put up a sign with health tips around town?
CSS.HC.winter_Mon: Don't forget to bundle up when you go out, alright? If you’re out for too long, make sure to warm up afterward.#$e#The winter is no joke, honey.
CSS.HC.winter_Mon_GN: Don't forget to bundle up when you go out, alright? If you’re out for too long, make sure to warm up afterward.#$e#The winter is no joke, {{TermOfEndearment}}.

CSS.HC.winter_1: Ah, flu season is here.$3#$b#Don't get me wrong, I do love my job but flu season means the Clinic is about to get swamped with villagers asking for a flu drop or prescriptions.$2#$e#Winter is the busiest season in the Clinic, after all.#$b#Oh, that reminds me - I ordered some fruits at Pierre's the other day. They're rich in Vitamin C to boost your immunity. [635][635][635][635][635]
CSS.HC.winter_2: Annual check-ups are such a great opportunity to reconnect with the people in the Valley.#$b#I get to really see how my patients are doing, both emotionally and physically. Personally, it's made my work feel so much more meaningful.$h
CSS.HC.winter_3: Evelyn came by the Clinic for their check-up with me yesterday. It's always a joy to see her in good spirits.#$b#Oh, by the way, she insisted on bringing us some cookies before she left.[223]$h#$e#They're shaped like little winter stars, too! What a thoughtful gesture..$h
CSS.HC.winter_7: Are you joining the Ice Fishing Contest, @? Just make sure you're properly bundled up for the cold.#be#Sigh, I just wish the ice wasn't so unpredictable. What if someone falls?$2#$e#Sorry, I don't want to overthink but it’s hard not to when there are potential hazards.
CSS.HC.winter_14: I haven't really been too enthusiastic with birthdays. I just never had the time to unwind nor celebrate.$2#$b#With you by my side, perhaps it's worth celebrating after all.$4.
CSS.HC.winter_20: I’m glad things haven’t gotten too hectic at the Clinic.#$b#Still, I have to stay extra cautious and keep reminding my patients to take care of themselves during this season.
CSS.HC.winter_23: It's a blessing to the see the older folks in the Valley faring well from the usual winter bugs.#$b#So far, I'm relieved that generally no one is coming down with anything serious lately.
CSS.HC.winter_28: The last day of the year feels like the perfect time to remind you how much you mean to me. I'm so lucky to have you by my side.#$b#Here's to us. I love you, @. $h #$action AddItem (O)348 1 3
CSS.HC.OneKid_0: It's quite ironic how I've spent my days as a doctor telling parents not to worry too much but when it comes to %kid1, I question every little thing that I do.$2
CSS.HC.OneKid_2: I'm glad I can count on Evelyn and Jodi for parental advice when they stop by for a checkup.$2#$b#Sigh, I don't think reading academic studies on infants and toddlers are enough..$2#$b#Hmm, maybe I should drop by the Library on my day off? See if Gunther keeps books for new time parents.
CSS.HC.OneKid_3: Being a parent changes the way you see everything. Logic just seems to take a back seat.$2#$e#I know it's probably nothing, but when it's my own child, I find myself clouded with worst-case scenarios.$2
CSS.HC.TwoKids_0: I can picture our kids running through %farm Farm and learning about the crops where their food comes from.#$b#Our farm is the perfect haven for %kid1 and %kid2 to make memories and learn about the world we live in.$h
CSS.HC.TwoKids_1: I wonder if any of our kids will share my fascination with planes and become a pilot one day.#$b#Honestly, I'd be just as proud if they followed a completely different path as long as they're happy.$h
CSS.HC.TwoKids_2: I gave %kid1 and %kid2 their vaccine shots today.$2#$b#It doesn't matter how many times I've seen it. The sound of their sobs and seeing their little faces scrunch up like that shatters my heart every time.$2
CSS.HC.TwoKids_3: @, my life is devoted to you and the children now, and I couldn't be happier.$2#$b#I always dreamed of having a wonderful family.$h#$e#I love you and our little ones so much.$4

CSS.HC.HAerobics.spring_Tue: Honestly, I didn’t expect to like aerobics this much. Since I started attending classes, I've noticed that my shoulders don't tense up the way they used to. I've been breathing easier, too!$h
CSS.HC.HAerobics.summer_Tue: Integrating aerobics into my weekly routine has been so good for my mental and physical health. Plus, it's nice to feel a part of something outside the Clinic.$h#$b#You should join us sometime, @. It’ll be fun.$h
CSS.HC.HAerobics.fall_Tue: It’s nice to see everyone outside the Clinic from time to time. It’s refreshing to just be another person in the room.#$e#Just another person trying to keep up, really.$h

What a thoughtful gesture..$h
CSS.HC.HAerobics.summer_22: George's seasonal check up is today. Mr. Mulner isn't exactly too thrilled to visit me at the Clinic, but it does help that Evelyn is there to calm him down.#$b#I can only hope we get to to grow old and continue supporting each other in the same way.$4#$e#Minus the grumpy part, of course.$h
CSS.HC.HAerobics.summer_23: Ah, the heat snuck in so early today. It's radiating with so much warmth in the house.#$b#Take this before you work, @. Prolonged exposure to the sun can deplete the body of water and essential nutrients, you know?[349][349][(H)4]
CSS.HC.HAerobics.fall_2: Evelyn came by the Clinic for their check-up with me yesterday. It's always such a joy to see her in good spirits.#$b#Oh, by the way, she insisted on bringing us some cookies before she left.[223]$h#$e#They're shaped like little pumpkins, too! What a thoughtful gesture..$h
CSS.HC.HAerobics.winter_2: Evelyn came by the Clinic for their check-up with me yesterday. It's always a joy to see her in good spirits.#$b#Oh, by the way, she insisted on bringing us some cookies before she left.[223]$h#$e#They're shaped like little winter stars, too! What a thoughtful gesture..$h
CSS.HC.HAerobics.spring_3: Annual check-ups are such a great opportunity to reconnect with the people in the Valley.#$b#I get to really see how my patients are doing, both emotionally and physically. Personally, it's made my work feel so much more meaningful.$h

CSS.HC.spring_Sun: Philip is trained in identifying deficiencies in the biomechanics of the body.#$b#Seeing how much care Philip puts into his work, I can rest easy knowing Shiro is in the best hands.$h
CSS.HC.spring_Fri: Yuuma comes by the Clinic to get his brother's medications. He's such a courteous kid..$h#$e#I hope he knows that his compassion plays a big role in his older brother's journey to recovery.
CSS.HC.spring_17: I get visits and consultations from villagers in the next town over. It’s nice to be of help..
CSS.HC.summer_Sun: Philip vists the clinic every now and then.#$b#Even though I’m technically his supervising physician, he's very skilled and knowledgeable of his field.#$e#I've definitely picked up a few tricks just by working with him.$h
CSS.HC.summer_8: Did you know Philip and I used to take exercise physiology classes back in university?#$b#It's amazing how far we've both grown since then.$h
CSS.HC.eventSeen_75160112_memory_oneday: Healing takes time. I can only imagine how tough it is for Shiro and Yuuma.$2#$b#I'm glad I get to witness Shiro recovering slowly but surely..$h#$e#I hope that as time goes on, he regains his confidence and ability to pursue what makes him happy.
CSS.HC.eventSeen_75160112_memory_oneweek: Yuuma is a big part of why Shiro's recovery has progressed so well. His support makes all the difference.
CSS.HC.eventSeen_75160111_memory_oneday: Yuuma's grown into such a responsible boy. I just hope he doesn’t miss out on being a kid...
CSS.HC.eventSeen_94621000_memory_oneweek: I heard from Philip that Yuuma's starting to do piano lessons.#$b#It's wonderful to see that boy exploring his own hobbies.$h
CSS.HC.fall_Sun: Dr. Paula and I have worked on a few cases together.#$b#Talking shop with another medical professional who understands the highs and lows of this field is a comfort I didn’t know I was missing.
CSS.HC.fall_5: I just received news about this revolutionary medicine being developed in Zuzu City that's supposed to cure a known disease.#$e#Maybe I should give Dr. Paula a call and hear her thoughts about it.
CSS.HC.fall_26: Did you know Dr. Paula's an army medic? I got to learn so much from her about the realities of emergency medical care outside of what we studied in med school.
CSS.HC.evelyn.married_Harvey: The town hasn't had a wedding in ages, dear. It was the lovelist thing I've seen in years.$1#$b#I pray your marriage lasts through every season.
CSS.HC.evelyn.spring_Mon_inlaw_Harvey: Your husband is such a kind soul. I see it in how he treats George and I.#$b#I see it in the warmth in his eyes whenever I bring up your name.#$e#May Yoba bless the love that you share, dear.
CSS.HC.evelyn.spring_Sun_inlaw_Harvey: Hi dear. It's nice of you to drop by.#$b#You must be the reason why Dr. Harvey smiles so much more nowadays.$1#$e#I pray your marriage lasts through every season.
CSS.HC.evelyn.spring_2_inlaw_Harvey: I have my appointment with Dr. Harvey soon. I always get a bit flustered before check-ups.$2#$e#Remember not to overwork yourself, dear.
CSS.HC.evelyn.summer_Wed_inlaw_Harvey: The recipe for a long and loving marriage consists not only of love but commitment, communication, and even forgiveness.#$e#I pray your marriage lasts through every season, dear.
CSS.HC.evelyn.summer_2_inlaw_Harvey: I have my appointment with Dr. Harvey soon. I always get a bit flustered before check-ups.$2#$e#Remember not to overwork yourself, dear.
CSS.HC.evelyn.fall_Mon10_inlaw_Harvey: With all the years I've lived, I’ve witnessed many kinds of love.#$b#Yours reminds me of the kind that stays. I pray you both keep choosing it everyday.
CSS.HC.evelyn.fall_Fri_inlaw_Harvey: You dropped by at just the right time, @. I just baked a fresh batch of cookies from the oven.#$b#Why don’t you take a few home for you and your husband, dear?[223]
CSS.HC.evelyn.winter_1_inlaw_Harvey: The cold keeps me from my flowers these days.$2#$b#The quiet of winter makes their return feel all the more precious.$1
CSS.HC.evelyn.winter_Wed_inlaw_Harvey: The recipe for a long and loving marriage consists not only of mutual respect and adoration but commitment, communication, and even forgiveness.#$e#I pray your marriage lasts through every season, dear.$1
CSS.HC.evelyn.winter_Fri_inlaw_Harvey: You dropped by at just the right time, @. I just baked a fresh batch of cookies from the oven.#$b#Why don’t you take a few home for you and your husband, dear?[223]
CSS.HC.george.married_harvey: Hmp.  Didn’t think I’d see any visitors today, much less you.#$b#Heard you're married to the 'ol doc now. Didn't think I'd see the day he'd settle down. I can see he's happier with you around.
CSS.HC.george.Fri10_inlaw_Harvey: He’s a good man, your spouse. Been around long enough to know when something’s real.#$b#I ain’t usually one for heart talk but if he ever gives you grief, you let me know.#$e#I'll roll over his toes.$3
CSS.HC.george.spring_Mon10_inlaw_Harvey: S'pose it’s alright the doc got married. Used to think he'd die married to his job.#$b#Hey, @...#$b#You've both got somethin' good. Don't be fools and forget that.
CSS.HC.george.spring_Tue10_inlaw_Harvey: You know, I used to bring my wife tulips when we were just courting.#$b#Wish I could go pick some now… but these legs, well.$2#$e#....$2
CSS.HC.george.spring_Sun10_inlaw_Harvey: Marriage ain't easy, @.  My missus, she stayed with me through my worst. Held me, even when I didn't ask.$2#$b#Don't take that love for granted, kid. I know I didn't.$1
CSS.HC.george.spring_23_inlaw_Harvey: If it were just up to me, I’d still be in bed. Hmp.#$b#You married a thorough one, I'll give you that.
CSS.HC.george.summer_Mon_inlaw_Harvey: My Evelyn's always had a way with growin' things in the garden. When we were young, I'd sit nearby and watch her work.#$b#Nowadays, I sit by the window and watch her tidy up the town planters.
CSS.HC.george.summer_23_inlaw_Harvey: If it were just up to me, I’d still be in bed. Hmp.#$b#You married a thorough one, I'll give you that.
CSS.HC.george.fall_Fri10_inlaw_Harvey: Wasn’t always so short-tempered, you know? But the world's been rough.$2#$b#My Evelyn never stopped lookin' at me like I was worth the trouble.
CSS.HC.george.fall_23_inlaw_Harvey: If it were just up to me, I’d still be in bed. Hmp.#$b#You married a thorough one, I'll give you that.
CSS.HC.george.winter_Fri10_inlaw_Harvey: Don’t tell him I said this, but… I’m still kickin' because of the 'ol doc.$1
CSS.HC.george.winter_23_inlaw_Harvey: Snow or no snow, guess I’m still expected to show up to the clinic.#$e#Hmp. Tell that fella of yours to keep the room warm next time. The cold is mean on my old bones.
CSS.HC.maru.married_Harvey: He finally tied the knot, huh? Guess I can expect to see you around the clinic more often, @.$1#$e#Hey, don’t be a stranger, alright?
CSS.HC.maru.Sat_inlaw_Harvey: Hey, @. It's nice to see you here. How's married life going?#$b#You should drop by more often. He perks up a little when you visit.$1
CSS.HC.maru.spring_Tue10_inlaw_Harvey: The doctor talks about home here and there. It's a nice change to see him so animated at work.
CSS.HC.maru.summer_Thu10_inlaw_Harvey: Hot days like these drain you fast. Don't let the heat wear you down, alright?#$b#Promise me you’re resting, too?
CSS.HC.maru.fall_Thu10_inlaw_Harvey: I catch Doctor Harvey fiddling with his mermaid pendant when he's stressed with work.$1#$b#Trust me, it's made him a lot calmer.
CSS.HC.maru.summer_Fri_inlaw_Harvey: Hey, @. You should come by the Clinic more often. He always gets in a better mood when you're around.$1
CSS.HC.maru.winter_Tue_inlaw_Harvey: Winter’s always been a bit of a mess in the Clinic. He seems calmer this year.#$b#Your presence in his life made a difference, @. I'm happy for you two.$1
CSS.HC.maru.winter_Thu_inlaw_Harvey: Hey, these cold months press heavy. Make sure you wrap up and come by the Clinic if anything feels off with you.
CSS.HC.lewis.married_Harvey: Congratulations on your beautiful marriage, @! I haven't officiated a marriage in a long time!$1#$e#You and Doctor Harvey make a good match.
CSS.HC.lewis.Sun10_inlaw_Harvey: To have someone like Doctor Harvey be a part of this town is a blessing to our community. He gives so much of himself to keep our people healthy.$1#$e#I can see that you keep him grounded, @. May your marriage carry you both through life's every turns.$1
CSS.HC.lewis.spring_Mon_inlaw_Harvey: I passed by the Clinic the other day and had a quick word with Doctor Harvey. He seems less stressed nowadays.#$b#Must be your doing, @.$1
CSS.HC.lewis.spring_Sun10_inlaw_Harvey: I’ve been around long enough to know the signs. That man adores you, even when he doesn’t even say it out loud.
CSS.HC.lewis.fall_Sat_inlaw_Harvey: I passed by the Clinic the other day. Your husband talks about you more than he realizes, you know.#$e#Young people in love is such a delight to see.$1
CSS.HC.jas.married_Harvey: You must be really special if Doctor Harvey married you!!$1#$b#He’s like… grown-up smart.$4
CSS.HC.vincent.married_Harvey: I drew a picture of your wedding!!!#$b#Uhm...I think I made your hair too spiky.$3#$e#...sorry.$2

css.hc.harvey_1: You’re awake! Thank Yoba you’re awake.$8
css.hc.harvey_2: When you were rushed here from the mines, you...were barely breathing. You came in covered in injuries, one after another.$2
css.hc.harvey_3: @, I've patched up countless people, responded to so many medical emergencies in the past even.$2#$b#But nothing prepares you for seeing the love of your life on the operating table.$2
css.hc.harvey_4: Please, @. ... you’re the one person in my life I cannot bear to be without.$2#$b#I need you to promise me that you’ll be more careful, alright?$2
